Fiorentina Steakhouse: USDA Prime Dry-Aged Steaks and Family-Style Dining in the Bronx

Fiorentina Steakhouse sits on E Tremont Avenue in the Tremont section of the Bronx, built around a simple idea: steakhouse dining should still feel like a family meal. The menu runs from USDA Prime dry-aged steaks, aged 28 days, to fresh seafood and classic American plates, alongside a wine list pulled from Tuscany, Liguria and Sicily.

The dining room seats up to 90, with a full bar and a daily happy hour from 12pm to 3:30pm. There's also a prix fixe lunch for those who want the Fiorentina experience without the full dinner commitment.

Whether it's a weeknight dinner or a private party, the move is the same: book a table or send an event inquiry directly through the restaurant.

What They're Known For

  • USDA Prime steaks, dry-aged 28 days
  • Private event rooms hosting 15 to 90 guests, including the Royal Room
  • Prix fixe lunch, $24.95 per person, daily 12pm to 3:30pm
  • Wine list sourced from Tuscany, Liguria and Sicily
  • ★ 4.8 (392 reviews)

What to Know Before You Reach Out

Online reservations run through OpenTable, with a 10 minute grace period on table times. Parties larger than 7 guests should use the party inquiry form instead of the standard booking flow. For private events, birthdays, or corporate gatherings, calling the restaurant directly at (718) 812-1112 is the fastest way to get details on the Main Room or the Royal Room and to work out a party package.

Get in Touch

For a table, a private party, or a first look at the dinner and wine menus, reach out directly through Fiorentina Steakhouse.
